name: Confluence
covers: Pages, spaces, search, comments, labels, attachments
credential: Personal access token (Data Center) or Atlassian account email and API token (Cloud)
credentialNote: One area for both: a Cloud connection sets deployment to cloud and an email, sent as Basic auth with the token. The default connection uses TOIL_JIRA_API_TOKEN when no Confluence token is set, only if the default Jira connection is the same deployment; another connection can borrow a Jira connection's token with apiTokenFrom. Both deployments are verified at the unit level, so the board shows one
credentialWhere: Data Center: your profile picture → Settings → Personal Access Tokens. Cloud: id.atlassian.com → Security → API tokens

supported.note: toil authenticates to Data Center with a personal access token, which Confluence Data Center added in 7.9. No release has been verified yet. Confluence Cloud (a connection with deployment cloud) is always current: toil calls REST API v2 (/wiki/api/v2) and, where v2 has no endpoint, v1 (/wiki/rest/api: CQL search, adding and removing labels, attachment uploads), with an Atlassian account email and API token sent as Basic auth. Nothing has been run against a live Cloud site yet.
